response.sql: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), with_ratio AS (SELECT ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_diff, avg_diff / (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) FROM per_patient) AS ratio FROM per_patient) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM with_ratio GROUP BY SEX
